## Export &amp; Graph Optimization

Built a static **PyTorch → ONNX opset-16 → QNN** pipeline with FastViT
reparameterization and normalization, SDPA, and EOS rewrites. Correcting
preprocessing raised fractional R@10 from 0.043 to 0.897.

## Accuracy &amp; Device Validation

Validated all **56 image and 211 text device outputs** at unchanged R@10 of
**0.897470**, with image/text cosine similarity of **0.999863/0.999998**.

Rejected calibrated W8A16 QDQ after image cosine similarity dropped to 0.811,
and isolated an S22/v69 DLC-composition failure. These checks informed the
deployment choice alongside latency measurements.
